name: CRAYM
aliases: Neural Field Optimization via Camera RAY Matching
definition: A method for 3D neural field optimization that constructs a 3D feature volume V to represent a target object, jointly optimizing camera poses and the implicit field by matching rays across different images to handle noisy camera poses.
summary: CRAYM is a 3D neural field optimization method that jointly optimizes camera poses and an implicit field to handle noisy poses, setting it apart from standard NeRF approaches that assume known poses.
